name: Apple

settings.job_url: https://jobs.apple.com/en-us/details/{h}/{transformedPostingTitle}?team={teamCode}  (h = positionId if id contains REQ/PIPE, else id)

feed: POST https://jobs.apple.com/api/v1/search {"query":"","filters":{},"page":N,"locale":"en-us","sort":"newest","format":{...}} (20 rows/page, no CSRF needed); student slice = Students team + exact-token queries "intern"/"internship"/"student" (306 rows, ~29 requests)
page_total_how: Playwright render of https://jobs.apple.com/en-us/search + 'Clear all': display is capped at '600+ Result(s)', but the page's own POST /api/v1/search (filters {}) returned totalRecords 6118 = feed. Exact count check below the cap: /en-us/search?team=internships-STDNT-INTRN showed '113 Result(s)' = API 113.
notes: Rows are posting x location (6118 rows); group alerts by positionId. The Students team (217) holds all 25 US intern rows but misses 38 student-titled rows abroad (functional teams), so add exact-token queries "intern"/"internship"/"student" (quoted; unquoted 'intern' prefix-matches 'international', 2124 rows). Bare /en-us/search geo-redirects to ?location=united-states-USA; use the API with empty filters.
